properties.description: A page in setup.html's layout and voice, linked from site/index.html (the "One brain across all your repositories" kicker and a line under "Try it") and from site/setup.html's header paragraph. Sections: what a hub is; make one with reflow2 alone in three steps (genesis; external_dependency with graph_id and design_address or design_export, relation part_of / uses with interfaces, mirror_surface via the link-projects skill, upstream_status with relation_not_stated / no_interface_to_follow; the hub skill: search_design member by member, propagate_change → continue_in → propagate_from with arriving_from, receive_from_design then send_to_design with moved / piece / derived, proposed until the owner accepts, loop_status); make one on flo2.io (the chat sentence, give it a design new or one you have, share once, link to https://flo2.io/hub/); a system of systems in two tiers with the rule of thumb; what is coming (operations by graph id, the on-demand view) named as intent. It says plainly that one call searching the hub and every member together is NOT built (req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks is accepted only), and the skill searches member by member. The footer says which release it was checked against, and tools/check_doc_versions.py lists hub.html among the site claims (14 now), with test_check_doc_versions.py mutating it like the others. Every tool and skill name on the page was confirmed in the repository. Built 2026-10-11 (98a6a06a + the version line at 8e303e29c). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
